title: Batch batch_1789497550 - 21 requests (7 buildings x 3 construction-phase stages each, via new Growth Group Request feature)
plan: 3 contact sheets (9,9,3 items) via Creative Claw nano-banana-2 @ ~16cr/sheet = ~48cr
Sheet A (9): Barn foundation/framing/walls, Chicken Coop foundation/framing/walls, Farmhouse foundation/framing/walls
Sheet B (9): Greenhouse foundation/framing/walls, Small Cabin foundation/framing/walls, Stable foundation/framing/walls

Each stage is reference-matched to its OWN existing finished building (struct_barn, struct_coop_chicken, etc.) and described in words per the batching rule - foundation shows only the base/footing, framing adds the wood skeleton, walls adds exterior walls/siding (still missing roof/windows/trim vs the finished reference)
All 21 items request a full 3D model (no icon-only flag) - Meshy image_to_3d (meshy-t2 smart-topology, mesh+texture) @ ~15cr each = ~315cr

This is the first real batch to come through the new Request Growth Group dialog - each of the 7 groups will auto-assemble once all 3 of its stages finish, using the group metadata (icon/growth_type/time_unit=percent, age 0-33/33-66/66-99) already attached to the requests
